subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: For an active non-streaming run such as tool execution, should soft steer abort and schedule a context-preserving follow-up, queue only at the next safe boundary, or support a resumable interruption contract?
rationale: Each option changes user-visible run continuity and shared session-state behavior; the supplied linked PR addresses a fallback case but does not by itself establish the permanent lifecycle contract.

options.title: Define safe-boundary soft steer
options.body: Preserve the current run through a documented safe boundary and inject the new message only where the runtime can retain ordering and state safely.

options.title: Abort into follow-up
options.body: Abort active non-streaming work and start a context-preserving follow-up turn when immediate steering cannot be delivered safely.

options.title: Design resumable interruption
options.body: Introduce an explicit paused/resumable run state only after agreeing the state, provider, and partial-output contract.

recommendation.title: Define safe-boundary soft steer
recommendation.body: Preserve the current run through a documented safe boundary and inject the new message only where the runtime can retain ordering and state safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history most directly associates this person with the current active/non-streaming steer lifecycle.
